entry.title: 3.2 Sovereign LLM Gateway (implementation note)
entry.summary: One control plane over four model backends with no prompt leaving the perimeter. Redaction before routing, deterministic stamped fallback, per-tenant quotas. 3.1M calls/day, p99 overhead 180 ms, falls over at roughly 11k rps and degrades to fail-open with an alarm.
